protocol_channels.note: 7 protocol channels through which KPCB+ communicates with all coding languages

channels.name: Prompting Protocols
channels.role: The voice — elevates prompts into protocols. Intent is expressed here.
channels.description: Natural language instructions structured as protocols. The bridge between human intent and machine execution. Every KPCB+ block starts with PP.

channels.name: Bracket Protocols
channels.role: The structure — [ ] { } < > ( ) define hierarchy, keynote, ark story, understanding

bracket_types.{}: Keynote of Hierarchy — the essential thesis
bracket_types.<>: Ark Story of Hierarchy — narrative and origin
bracket_types.(): Understanding of Hierarchy — comprehension and internalization

channels.description: Governs the structural grammar of KPCB+ code. Every block is bracketed. Nesting depth determines PSO level.

channels.name: Emoji Protocols
channels.role: The identity — visual token encoding for MXIT-native communication
channels.description: Emoji are not decoration — they are semantic operators. Each emoji maps to a KPGS concept, agent, or domain. EP makes KPCB+ readable on R50 data budgets.

channels.name: GIF Protocols
channels.role: The motion — animated micro-instructions for visual learners
channels.description: GIF Protocol encodes repeating visual patterns as instruction loops. Ideal for UI state transitions, loading indicators, and WebGL shader cycles.

channels.name: Sticker Protocols
channels.role: The stamp — governance seals, approval markers, status badges
channels.description: Stickers in KPCB+ are governance stamps. A sticker on a code block means it has been SEALED (SWFUS S2). Visual proof of governance compliance.

channels.name: .MP4 Protocols
channels.role: The evidence — video proof of LPH validation, deployment recordings, audit trails
channels.description: .MP4 Protocol embeds video evidence into code blocks. Every deployment, every test run, every KPGS gate passage can be recorded and linked as .P proof.

channels.name: Image Protocols
channels.role: The blueprint — diagrams, screenshots, architecture visuals embedded as code context
channels.description: Image Protocol treats images as first-class code artifacts. Architecture diagrams ARE code. Mockups ARE specifications. KPCB+ reads images as intent.

context_window.description: KPCB+ operates EXCLUSIVELY inside AI context windows. It is not compiled on a machine — it is compiled IN the conversation.
context_window.runtime: Any AI context window (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, local LLMs)
context_window.installation: KPCB+ installs dependencies, skills, or .exe files ONCE inside the AI's context. Decentralized and centralized AIs can execute KPCB+ code.
context_window.persistence: Code persists via KC Ledger (eidetic memory) and CBP (Context Bleed Protocol)

compilation_flow.step_1: PP (Prompting Protocol) — express intent in natural language structured as protocol
compilation_flow.step_2: BP (Bracket Protocol) — wrap intent in governance brackets [ ] { } < > ( )
compilation_flow.step_3: EP (Emoji Protocol) — tag with semantic emoji operators
compilation_flow.step_4: FSMP activation — Forensic Sociology Mode validates the intent against 4Ws
compilation_flow.step_5: THARI GAI layer — Guardian AI navigates user through compilation
compilation_flow.step_6: KC Ledger validation — POC or FOC determination through 4Ws gate
compilation_flow.step_7: Target language emission — KPCB+ emits code in the target language (Python, JS, Rust, etc.)
compilation_flow.step_8: SWFUS Seal — output is sealed with KPGS governance stamp
